name: Hallowed Sigil
summary: The Hallowed Sigil is an introductory summons delivered to young night elf priests beginning their training in Shadowglen. Conservator Ilthalaine passes along the message from the priest trainer Shanda, directing novice practitioners to seek guidance within Aldrassil as they learn to wield Elune's grace.

sections.title: A Calling to Service
sections.body: Priests in night elf culture occupy a sacred place as handmaidens and servants of the moon goddess, Elune. When a young kaldorei in Shadowglen shows an affinity for the divine light and devotion, Conservator Ilthalaine entrusts them with a hallowed sigil. Sent by messenger from the priest trainer Shanda, the token serves as a formal invitation to present oneself at the tree of Aldrassil to begin dedicated spiritual tutelage.

sections.title: A Changing World
sections.body: Upon meeting Shanda, the young acolyte finds that the sheltered sanctuary of Teldrassil is experiencing unusual upheaval. Shanda notes that the boughs of the World Tree are stirring with travelers, including members of the wider Alliance granted leave to meet with the kaldorei. While the broader world calls, Shanda advises novices to ground themselves in the troubles immediately facing Shadowglen before venturing into the wider conflicts beyond.

faq.answer: It is an inscribed token sent by the priest trainer Shanda via messenger to Conservator Ilthalaine, meant to summon a novice priest for instruction in Aldrassil.
Shanda is the priest trainer stationed at Aldrassil in Shadowglen. She guides fledgling night elf priests in the fundamental rites, disciplines, and prayers of the Sisterhood of Elune.

aliases: where to turn in hallowed sigil
faq.answer: Shanda resides inside the hollow base of Aldrassil, the massive central tree at the heart of Shadowglen in Teldrassil.

faq.q: Why are Alliance members visiting Teldrassil?
faq.answer: The night elves have forged ties with the Alliance following the Third War. Outside races are beginning to arrive on Teldrassil's boughs to coordinate and confer with the kaldorei as both sides prepare for the challenges facing Azeroth.

faq.q: What should a priest do after completing this task?
faq.answer: Shanda advises priests to assist the local defenders and caretakers across Shadowglen, returning to her whenever they need to learn new prayers and techniques.

faq.q: Why does Ilthalaine give this quest?
faq.answer: Conservator Ilthalaine oversees the earliest trials of novices in Shadowglen. When a messenger from Shanda arrived with the sigil, Ilthalaine held it until the aspiring priest proved capable of taking their next steps.

angles.text: This rite of passage connects a novice kaldorei priest with Shanda, initiating their formal training in the light and wisdom of Elune.
The priesthood is central to kaldorei culture, governed by ancient traditions of lunar devotion that have guided their people for millennia.
Shanda's remarks highlight how newly established Alliance alliances are bringing unfamiliar races and travelers directly onto Teldrassil's boughs.
